title: Logos 13 opening: likeness of Son to Father; not turnable nature
english: Thirteenth discourse. On the Son’s likeness to the Father, and that his nature is not turnable.
Likeness is natural, not moral-only; the Son is not a changeable creature.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
